36 first-degree misdemeanor counts of keeping animals in an enclosure without exercise and air
First court appearance on August 11
Judge ordered ODonnell may not own or possess any animals as condition of bond
Investigation began in 2020
ODonnell claimed she had no more than five dogs during investigation
All animals turned over to Humane Society of the Treasure Coast
Humane Society asking for public donations
